name: Keep
text:
#!name=Keep
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partK/Keep.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
keep_enable = switch,true,false,tag=keep-脚本开关

[Rule]
# 感谢【可莉🅥】分享
# 拦截HTTPDNS
DOMAIN, httpdns.n.netease.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns.calorietech.com, REJECT
# 拦截广告下发
DOMAIN, hc-ssp.sm.cn, REJECT
DOMAIN, apm.gotokeep.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, kad.gotokeep.com, REJECT


[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/static1\.keepcdn\.com\/ark_optimus\/202\d\/*\/*\/.*.(png|jpg)/i then reject(200)
# 屏蔽应用内弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/guide-webapp\/v\d\/popup\/getPopUp/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽部分启动弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/kprime\/v\d\/popups\/primeGuide/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽开屏广告请求
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/kad\.gotokeep\.com\/op-engine-webapp\/v\d\/ad/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽青少年弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api.gotokeep.com\/cauchy\/growth\/init/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽搜索栏自动填充词
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/search\/v\d\/default\/keyword\/list/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽热词
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/search\/v\d\/hotword\/list/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽hotCourse
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/search\/v\d\/hotCourse\/list/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽adwebapp
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/op-engine-webapp\/v\d\/ad/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽广告预加载
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/ads\/v\d\/ads\/preload/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽adbox
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/training\/box\/config/i then reject(404)
# 屏蔽更新
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/anno\/v\d\/upgrade\/check/i then reject(404)


[Script]
# 我的页面去推广
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/athena\/v\d\/people\/my$/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/keep.js") with enable=${keep_enable}, tag="keep", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 应用底部栏净化
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/config\/v\d\/basic/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/keep.js") with enable=${keep_enable}, tag="keep", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 发现页处理
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/homepage\/v\d\/tab/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/keep.js") with enable=${keep_enable}, tag="keep", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 课程预览页广告
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/nuocha\/course\/v\d\/\w+\/preview/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/keep.js") with enable=${keep_enable}, tag="keep", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 我的运动页面去除下方推荐
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.gotokeep\.com\/sportpage\/sport\/v\d\/mysport/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/keep.js") with enable=${keep_enable}, tag="keep", timeout=60, requires_body=true


[MITM]
hostname = api.gotokeep.com, kad.gotokeep.com, static1.keepcdn.com
